findings.title: Callable constructor preconnect runs the native connect target before guarded adoption
findings.mechanism: Connection invokes native_class callable; a returned native instance is adopted and bind_connect_target is applied only after constructor returns. Exact inherited HTTPConnection.connect in that constructor performs its audited create-connection effect without request/cap/endpoint custody guard.
findings.observed_actual: Six host/port/revoke/key/cap-replacement/original-carrier audit mutations reach the benign owned memory create-connection target; later ScopeDenied stops send but cannot undo connect. Normal native class/factory and class preconnect remain positive; corresponding normal connect negatives refuse before effect.
findings.effects_scope: Owned inert memory socket targets only; no DNS, network, TLS, model, native TUI or installed runtime call.

findings.title: Lazy constructor preconnect binding accepts target replacement after native connect audit
findings.mechanism: Before first constructor-preconnect access, no connect_targets record exists. Native connect audit can replace _create_connection; read_connect_target then binds that replacement as original.
findings.observed_actual: Both class and callable factory constructor-preconnect execute the substituted owned memory function, send the request and return fixture catalog successfully. Explicit invocation witnesses and closure retained.
findings.effects_scope: Owned inert memory socket targets only; no DNS, network, TLS, model, native TUI or installed runtime call.

eight_invalid_fixture_assertions: Retained diagnostic errors separately; corrected fixtures do not erase original failures.
resource_closure: All final owned interpreters returned; zero open owned handles/threads, zero foreign disposal. Successful cleanup does not close the two effect-boundary findings.
